_doc: Every feature of the pipeline: owner = a role card in team/roles/, check = a style/checklist.json item or gate:<file>, check may be {long: id, short: id} when each form has its own item; use per form = required | report | infra | never (capabilities.py). Generated 2026-11-09 from the code (capabilities.discover) and the plans of film 2026-11-04 (a key the long never set -> required now when it changes the film: broll, grade, sfx_duck). tests/test_capabilities.py fails on a feature of the code without an entry here. A "required" use needs evidence: its own why, or the why of its checklist item of that form. Kinds opt (a key inside a card/scene spec) and menu (a list the role picks from, shown by brief, not counted per film) added in round 3 (2026-11-09). Round 4: kind pfx (a field of a scene piece, els[]); "group": one of the members of that form is enough (long.explainers needs a scene, float, slide or web card; long.memes a meme or sticker); a cap skip needs >= 10 characters and an existing id. Round 5: spec keys read by any stage (*.py), fields of objects inside a piece (pfx.rows.*, msgs.*, count.*, badge.*), groups end (card.end / plan.end) and framing (part_framing / zoom_every_s), never-uses where the renderer refuses the canvas. Round 6: "want" = only these values count (caption_emph key, hook_pos mid, end platform: a default does not); fields of spec lists (opt.cam.*, opt.canvas_zoom.*); read_along required on the scene pieces, where long.read_along looks.
